blocks.html: With the metropolis growing year by year, congestion is bound to happen. For most people, being confined to cramped spaces is not only stifling to movement but also un-liberating to the senses. Thus, it benefits one to live in places with ample spaces; free from the hustle and bustle of densely populated areas. Antipolo City, aside from being a pilgrim site, offers much in food choices as well as sites to visit. The many access points to and from the city makes it an ideal place to stay. Only a few minutes-drive to and from Ortigas Center, it is the ideal location to set up one’s home – far from the din yet near to all the essentials of modern-day living: schools, hospitals, mode of transport, commercial centers, and churches. Robinsons Homes continues to be the lead in providing quality and value-for-money homes in Antipolo. Backed up with more than twenty years of experience, Robinsons Homes remains a dominant property brand in Antipolo and the rest of the Eastern part of the metropolis. This year, the house brands and home designs under Robinsons Homes’ Parkhomes House Series are brought to the fore in one of its 5 properties in Antipolo – St. Judith Hills, located along the Antipolo-Teresa Highway in Barangay San Jose. Under the Parkhomes series, well-ventilated homes sporting sleek and modern contemporary aesthetics will soon rise in this prime property. Lot owners can build their dream houses on amply-sized lots with a pre-dominant lot cut of 125 sqm. On the other hand, those who want to occupy townhouses can choose from offered units with wide floor spaces. These soon to be ready for occupancy townhouses are perfect for startup families that value sharing intimate moments with their loved ones. Those who have been living in Antipolo, and those who are thankful that they did, will attest to the easy and laid-back community living amid elevated and breezy environs with splendid views all around it. It is one of the remaining unspoiled spaces in a rapidly congested metropolis. [gallery ids="1012,1013,1014,1015,1016"] Experience the elegance of the Robinsons Homes brand of living in any of its Antipolo subdivisions: St. Judith Hills, San Jose Estates, Robinsons Homes East, St. Bernice Estates, and San Lorenzo Homes. Needless to say, all of these subdivision developments offer substantial pieces of prime land space at very affordable price points.
